standards.title: Permit-Required Confined Spaces
standards.summary: Requires employers to evaluate the workplace to determine if confined spaces are present and whether they are permit-required. Mandates a written permit system, atmospheric testing, rescue procedures, and trained attendants.

standards.title: Control of Hazardous Energy (Lockout/Tagout)
standards.summary: Requires energy control procedures, employee training, and periodic inspections to prevent unexpected energization or startup of machinery during servicing.

standards.title: Air Contaminants — Permissible Exposure Limits (PELs)
standards.summary: Establishes permissible exposure limits for hundreds of air contaminants. TWA and ceiling limits are defined. Employers must limit worker exposure to listed substances.

standards.title: Fall Protection Systems Criteria and Practices
standards.summary: Specifies requirements for fall protection systems including guardrails, safety nets, and personal fall arrest systems. Applies to work at heights of 1.8 m or more in construction.

standards.title: Occupational Noise Exposure
standards.summary: Requires a hearing conservation program when noise exposures equal or exceed 85 dBA as an 8-hour TWA. PEL is 90 dBA. Hearing protection, monitoring, and audiometric testing required.

standards.title: Respirable Crystalline Silica — Construction
standards.summary: Establishes a permissible exposure limit (PEL) of 50 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA and an action level of 25 µg/m³ for respirable crystalline silica in construction.

standards.title: Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals
standards.summary: Requires employers with processes involving highly hazardous chemicals to develop and implement a comprehensive management program including process hazard analysis, operating procedures, training, and emergency planning.

standards.title: Selection and Use of Work Practices — Electrical Safety
standards.summary: Requires deenergizing equipment before working on or near electrical conductors where possible. When energized work is required, specific safeguards including PPE and insulated tools must be used.
